prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one standalone square iOS app icon for Workoutes, a personal strength workout and exercise notes app.
Primary request: design a distinctive icon of an Olympic EZ curl bar where the actual bent central shaft unmistakably forms a wide uppercase W, referencing the app name Workoutes. It must read simultaneously as a W and as an EZ curl bar.
Geometry: one continuous substantial round tubular shaft, not a ribbon and not a W placed on top of a straight bar. Seen straight on, fully horizontal, symmetrical. From the left short horizontal sleeve, the shaft descends diagonally into the first low rounded valley, rises to a central rounded high peak, descends into the second low rounded valley, then rises to the right short horizontal sleeve. This makes exactly two valleys and one central peak, a readable W. Moderate deliberate bends inspired by a real EZ curl bar, slightly exaggerated for letter recognition. Make the shaft broad enough to read at 60px. The W-shaped shaft occupies most of the width of the symbol, with compact broad rounded weight plates on each end; exactly one main vertical plate plus one smaller outer collar per end. Small plates must frame the W rather than dominate it. A single continuous believable gym equipment silhouette. No straight connecting bar crossing the W.
Composition: one centered symbol occupying about 74% of canvas width and 42% height, generous uncluttered margins. Exact orthographic front view, no perspective or rotation.
Style: polished simple native iOS icon, soft rounded sculptural surfaces, shallow depth and soft subtle shadow; restrained dimensional ceramic rather than photorealistic gym equipment. Quietly confident, clean and friendly. Pale ivory shaft and plates, petrol-blue shaded edges. Strong contrast against a full-bleed rich petrol blue #326884 square background with a restrained soft mint-blue ambient glow near upper corner, in keeping with the existing Workoutes palette.
Constraints: opaque full square image with no pre-rounded outer corners, the OS masks the corners. No outer mockup, no phone, no tile floating on a background, no notebook, no check, no arrow, no extra letter or standalone typography, no text, no tiny knurling, no decorative details, no logos of existing brands, no watermark. The W is physically the bar itself.
